metadata.description: it-guy-pro — personal IT guy for non-technical users by xiaolai

plugins.name: it-guy-pro
plugins.description: Personal IT guy for non-technical users — 9 plain-language commands (checkup, cleanup, organize, fix, automate, toolbox, backup, onboard, profile), 4 specialized agents, observation-first onboarding that asks exactly one question (your name — the IT guy himself is summoned from any session by typing _it), a machine profile that persists across sessions, a safety hook that blocks destructive shell commands, and a toolbox that turns every repeated chore into a reusable micro-tool. macOS-first.
